parsed.answer: Article 101 applies from 2 August 2026. Chapter XII (penalties) generally applied from 2 August 2025, but Article 113(b) expressly excludes Article 101 from that earlier date. Models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 have until 2 August 2027 to comply (Article 111(3)).

parsed.quote: shall be deemed to comply with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15 of that Regulation
parsed.answer: No. The presumption is in Article 12(1) of the Cyber Resilience Act, not in the AI Act. Under Article 71(2) of the Cyber Resilience Act, that Regulation, including Article 12, applies from 11 December 2027. Only some provisions apply earlier: the reporting obligations in Article 14 from 11 September 2026, and the notification of conformity assessment bodies (Chapter IV) from 11 June 2026. So on 5 October 2026 a high-risk AI system cannot yet rely on CRA compliance to be deemed to meet Article 15 of the AI Act. Once it applies, the presumption covers systems that meet the CRA's Annex I essential requirements, as shown in the EU declaration of conformity. Recital 77 of the AI Act reflects this.
